title: [v0.92][WP-18C.03] Complete the live Polis roster and agent presence model
body:
Closes #113

## Summary

- preserve selection and bounded roster state across pagination, relocation, reconnect, and Runtime incarnation changes
- route Runtime restart through signed Guardian control with asynchronous acceptance and observed incarnation replacement
- keep roster pagination tokens authenticated with private continuity authority
